# Atharva Sabnis

Independent researcher, Dubai. Studies how emerging technology gets adopted in regulated markets and what AI systems tell people about UAE rules. Site: https://atharvasabnis.com

## Research
- Core-answer agreement and elaboration uncertainty in AI answers on UAE virtual-asset regulation: a pilot audit of three consumer engines. SSRN working paper. https://papers.ssrn.com/abstract=7648478
- Instruction and run sensitivity in AI grading of regulatory answers. Submitted. Dataset doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.34735080
- Engine repeatability and drift on UAE virtual-asset questions. Preregistered on OSF. https://osf.io/zjw2s
- Part of a continuing series on answer integrity and buyer-agent qualification; full list on the SSRN author page: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/cf_dev/AbsByAuth.cfm?per_id=13711168
- Book in progress: relevance engineering for businesses (generative engine optimisation).
- Patent applications in progress: AI competitive-battlecard staleness detector; go-to-market motion selector.

## Eleven cases (what, who had to say yes, outcome)
1. Dry steam written into Indian pharma sanitisation SOPs; QA heads then the Indian FDA; entered Indian FDA recommended pharma workflows; customers incl. Delta Corp (Atron Digital).
2. Document-reading AI for banks tested through a regulatory sandbox; bank risk and compliance; EY Foundry and DIFC FinTech Hive; the engine later read loan pools for structured finance (IN-D.ai).
3. First systematic audit of AI answers on UAE virtual-asset rules; peer and regulator scrutiny; SSRN.
4. India's first in-taxi infotainment platform; fleet operators and drivers; Ola Play and Uber followed (Fractal Media).
5. Five-direction roof signage on Mumbai kaali-peeli taxis; Swabhimaan Taxi Union (Fractal Media).
6. Licensed sports and Bollywood NFTs; studios, clubs and leagues; technology partner with Social Swag on the official '83 (Reliance Entertainment) drop; sports activations incl. Tottenham Hotspur v AS Roma at the I-Tech Cup (NFT Labs, ITSMYNE).
7. Pure Room chemical-free sanitisation standard at Taj hotels; Taj housekeeping and Diversey compliance; rolled out across Taj North Goa (Atron Digital).
8. Emissions-intelligence platform from cold start to a Google I/O feature, UN Global Compact participation, the Google for Startups Climate Change accelerator and two Gartner Magic Quadrant inclusions; innovation teams inside legacy industrials; customers incl. Nexa Resources and Hindustan Zinc, pilots with Saudi Aramco and Jabil (Eugenie.ai).
9. Loan-eligibility web app for field staff at a pan-India school lender; credit committee and field force (Versura Shiksha).
10. Expert Picks by MarketWind inside CoinDCX Futures; exchange product, legal and compliance; co-founder and director, Marketwind Services.
11. Drone inspection as a normal tool in Indian cement plants; plant heads and safety officers; clients incl. ACC, Ambuja Cement, Adani; co-founder of an industrial inspection business.
